title: Quality Control General Assembly Engineering Information Specialist

cond_0001.intro: As the person responsible for quality control of completed vehicles, you will report to the Assistant Manager for Quality Control.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Implement actions and drive quality improvement through the collection, analysis, and reporting of quality data.
Analyze internal and external quality indicators to determine trends and drive continuous improvement.
Research and investigate quality issues to determine root cause.
Support execution and implementation of quality inspection and improvement activities for mass-produced vehicles.
Conduct analysis of completed vehicles to ensure conformity to international standards.
Quality Inspection
Establish/improve inspection methods to prevent leakage/flow out of post-processes.
Support development and maintenance of attendance tracking and analysis.
Improvement
Analyze vehicle problems and facilitate improvement activities.
Analyze statistical and historical quality data and drive improvement through trend analysis.
Manage quality facility/equipment and investment cost.
Coordinate external events and participate in new vehicle projects.
Other Duties
Manage ongoing systems and operations.
Monitor vehicle faults and ensure adequacy of relevant procedures and computerized systems.
Plan, control, and monitor corrective actions for quality non-conformities.
Support company certifications and generate troubleshooting reports.
Travel Requirement
Domestic/International travel required.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree (preference: STEM)
2+ Years of related experience in Quality Control or automobile-related teams
Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PowerBI, and Microsoft 365 products
Ability to work with a team, plan and organize, problem solve, and communicate effectively
Ability to use logic and reasoning to identify solutions to complex problems
Preferred Requirements
Background in Computer Science Engineering, Information Science/Technology Engineering, or IT Programming
Proficiency in programming using different software
Strategic thinking, flexibility, and willingness for transformational changes
Efficiently execute tasks and maintain quality through continuous monitoring
Customer-focused, collaborative, and globally-minded

cond_0222.intro: As the person responsible for quality control of completed vehicles, you will report to the Assistant Manager for Quality Control. You will regularly connect with internal teams to implement actions and drive quality improvement through the collection, analysis, and reporting of quality data. A large part of the role involves staying in contact with cross-functional teams to analyze internal and external quality indicators, determine trends, and support continuous improvement.
cond_0222.responsibilities:
Quality Inspection
Establish and improve inspection methods to prevent leakage and flow out of post-processes.
Support development and maintenance of attendance tracking and analysis.
Improvement
Analyze vehicle problems and actively facilitate improvement activities with relevant teams.
Analyze statistical and historical quality data and communicate improvement opportunities through trend analysis.
Manage quality facility and equipment and investment cost.
Coordinate external events and participate in new vehicle projects, staying in regular contact with project stakeholders.
Other Duties
Manage ongoing systems and operations.
Monitor vehicle faults and ensure adequacy of relevant procedures and computerized systems.
Plan, control, and monitor corrective actions for quality non-conformities.
Support company certifications and generate troubleshooting reports.
Travel: Domestic and international travel required.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science Engineering, Information Science/Technology Engineering, IT Programming, or a related STEM field.

Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PowerBI, and Microsoft 365 products.
Proficiency in programming using different software.
Strong problem-solving skills using logic and reasoning to identify solutions to complex problems.
Able to work collaboratively and communicate clearly with team members and stakeholders on a daily basis.

Experience with strategic thinking and flexibility in the face of transformational changes.
Ability to plan, organize, and efficiently execute tasks while maintaining quality through continuous monitoring.
Customer-focused, collaborative, and globally-minded approach.

Support execution and implementation of quality inspection and improvement activities for mass-produced vehicles.

Establish and improve inspection methods to prevent leakage or flow out of post-processes.

Proficiency in programming using different software
Ability to use logic and reasoning to identify solutions to complex problems
Domestic and international travel required

Strategic thinking and flexibility toward process change

Clear written communication and direct verbal reporting
